ContainerDeploymentView.description:
The container contract embeds a summary, never Deployment configuration or
resource bindings. These are read-model fields, not a cross-feature entity.

id.description: Docker container ID; the statistics containerId is Citadel's database UUID.

ExternalRepository.description: Repository summaries returned by the registry browser, never credentials.

LatestActivityView.description: Activity summary embedded in resource HTTP and realtime responses.

registryHost.description: Required for custom registry addresses; inferred for Docker Hub and GitHub.

PlatformPatch.description: Omitted fields preserve their stored value. Only address and description allow null.

RegistryConfigurationPatch.description: Partial provider settings; omission preserves a value and null removes it.

RegistryConfigurationView.description: Public settings and credential presence; secret values are write-only.

WebhookActivityDetails.description:
Safe webhook audit metadata. Authentication headers, credentials and request
bodies are deliberately not representable in the persisted event.

WebhookConfig.description: Shared webhook wire configuration and defaults.

WebhookPatch.description: Partial configuration. Defaults belong to creation, never to omitted patch fields.
